review.notes: Baseline implements lineage v0 (SDY-031, Starter Deck: Yugi, 2002-03-29) exactly. v0 -> v4 (SS03-ENA26, 2019-08-01) is wording only: 'face-up' is added at v1 (YSD-EN032, 2006-03-23) although both scripts already require a face-up target; 'selected' -> 'Target'; and the duration alternates between 'until the end of this turn' (v1, v2, v4) and 'until the End Phase' (v3, DT01-EN049, 2010-01-29) with no script correlate. The chkc:IsLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) vs chkc:GetLocation()==LOCATION_MZONE difference is an idiom. Engine-vs-ruling: see the Pyramid Energy note - the GOAT rule profile's damage-step flags do not rewrite per-effect Damage Step legality, so the substitution is not redundant and this is 'ruling', not 'engine'.

event.historical_text: Increase 1 selected monster's ATK by 500 points during the turn this card is activated.
event.summary: Period Damage Step activation window, encoded per-card: the GOAT variant registers the activation with EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET+EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL and a condition that only refuses activation once damage has been calculated, so Reinforcements can be activated during damage calculation; the modern script uses EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP + aux.StatChangeDamageStepCondition, confining it to the Damage Step before damage calculation. Targeting is unchanged (EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET and the face-up-monster target filter are identical), and the reset difference is the same constant written out. Chronology unresolved: nothing in the packet dates the narrowing.
